lesson.title: Procedure 201 – RADIO FREQUENCY FAILURE
lesson.topic: Radio Failure Troubleshooting and ECS/Transit Radio Check Procedures
objectives: Identify when Procedure 201 is triggered (loss of transmitting/receiving capability).
Apply Step 1 diagnostics to identify whether the problem is transmit, receive, or signal quality related.
Apply Step 2 solutions, including console checks and switching to the Standby Base Station when needed.
Apply escalation steps: alternate Base Station, ECS takeover behavior, and required advisory transmission.
Apply supervisor notification and log book documentation requirements.
Apply Transit dispatcher actions when a field unit reports a malfunction.
Use platform radio check outcomes to describe the correct condition to radio repair.

questions.stem: Procedure 201 SCOPE: When is Procedure 201 used?

choices.text: When radio checks are completed normally
When a radio failure causes loss of transmitting or receiving capabilities

questions.solution: The SCOPE states the procedure applies when a radio failure results in loss of transmitting/receiving capabilities.
questions.hints: Look for 'radio failure' + 'loss of transmitting or receiving'.

source.coverage: Radio failure causing loss of transmitting/receiving capabilities—procedure must be followed

questions.stem: Transit Dispatchers (Procedure 201): If the reporting unit is ALONE, what must the dispatcher do?

Have the unit call the media desk
Dispatch another unit to the location

questions.solution: Transit Step 1a says if the unit is alone, dispatch another unit to the location.
